info.title: ATMS - API
info.description:
Expose the REST APIs used by the ATMS Web UI.

## Authentication (Bearer Token)

The ATMS API uses the Bearer Token authentication scheme. The token is passed in the `Authorization` header of the
request. The token is obtained by calling the `/rest/atms/users/0/login` endpoint.

A current, valid ATMS user account is required to access the module.
